title: The green GUI's
description: The Green GUIs is a texture pack for Minecraft that makes the GUIs green. Download now & Join my Discord server now!
body:
# 🟢 Welcome to The Green GUIs!

**The Green GUIs** gives Minecraft’s interfaces a fresh, modern green look. If you are looking for a **clean aesthetic GUI**, a refreshed **custom HUD**, or a vibrant **dark green UI**, this is the perfect choice for your game!

Inventories, chests, crafting tables, furnaces, and many other interactive container interfaces are redesigned with a clean, consistent style, **bright green accents**, and optimized **good readability**. The resource pack keeps the original vanilla feel while adding a unique, vibrant look for players who love green-themed designs.

***

### 💬 Community & Support

Want to report a bug, suggest a mod to support, or chat with the creator? 👉 **[Join my Discord server now!](https://discord.com/invite/dEfp2jXqfd)**
